svg.title: Fifteen years of authorities that lied
svg.desc: Timeline: 2011 Comodo RA breach and DigiNotar breach; 2012 TURKTRUST intermediate used against google.com (found December); 2013 RFC 6962; 2015 CNNIC and MCS Holdings, and a Symantec test certificate for google.com found in CT logs; 2018 Chrome requires CT for new certificates and distrusts Symantec; 2024 Chrome distrusts Entrust; 2025 Firefox enforces CT and twelve Fina certificates for 1.1.1.1 are found in CT logs.

text.tspan: red: a CA issued what it should not amber: caught or punished through CT green: the system changing
